title: MV Pre-order Quotation Leader
desc:
Join Eaton, a global leader where equality and inclusivity are at the heart of our mission. Here, everyone is valued and belongs. Be part of a team that delivers cutting-edge, energy-efficient solutions, making a tangible impact on the world. We empower our customers to manage electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical energy more effectively, safely, and sustainably. At Eaton, we’re dedicated to enhancing quality of life and protecting the environment with our innovative energy management technologies and services.
What You’ll Do
As the
MV Pre-order Quotation Leader
, you will lead the Medium Voltage Pre-order team and drive the development of competitive, technically compliant, profitable, and executable offers across the EMEA region.
This role combines
technical expertise, commercial acumen, and leadership
to ensure high-quality quotations, effective risk management, and profitable growth. You will work closely with Sales, Business Development, Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Operations teams to develop winning customer solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the MV Pre-order team, ensuring accurate, competitive, and timely quotations.
Drive opportunity qualification, Bid/No-Bid decisions, bid strategy, pricing, and deal approvals.
Ensure quotations are technically compliant, commercially sound, and aligned with growth, profitability, and customer satisfaction objectives.
Identify and mitigate technical, commercial, contractual, and execution risks throughout the quotation process.
Monitor quotation performance, margins, win rates, and delivery timelines.
Partner with cross-functional teams to develop customer-focused solutions and support successful project execution through effective handover of key assumptions, commitments, and risks.
Coach and develop team members, building technical, commercial, and leadership capabilities while supporting succession planning.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
7+ years of experience in quotation, tendering, bid management, or commercial roles within the electrical power distribution industry
Strong knowledge of Medium Voltage switchgear, applications, and power distribution systems
Expertise in bid strategy, pricing, risk assessment, and commercial decision-making
Fluent written and spoken English
Skills
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills
People management experience
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
